definitions: A request to merge changes from one branch into another in a version control system like Git.

A feature in web-based hosting services for version control repositories (e.g., GitHub, GitLab) that allows developers to propose changes and have them reviewed before being integrated into the main codebase.
examples: I submitted a pull request for the new feature.
The team reviewed the pull request and provided feedback.
Can you approve this pull request?
The pull request was merged after several revisions.
